style: Painterly gouache travel-poster illustration, French Guiana, warm golden late-afternoon light, lush deep canopy greens with warm ochre and terracotta accents, soft visible brush texture, rich atmospheric depth, vertical 3:4 composition with calm sky area in the upper third, no text, no letters, no logos, no signage, no watermark.

images.ceperou: Grassy hilltop with the low ruined stone walls of an old colonial fort, view over the red rooftops of Cayenne, a wide brown estuary and the Atlantic at sunset, a few royal palms.
images.marche-cayenne: Morning inside a large open-sided tropical market hall with a metal roof, stalls of mangoes, rambutans, chili peppers and spice jars, steam rising from bowls of Vietnamese noodle soup at a food counter, shoppers seen from behind.
images.musee-cultures: Quiet museum gallery with polished wooden floor, display cases of Amerindian basketry, carved Maroon wooden paddles and stools with geometric tembé patterns, colourful embroidered textiles, soft daylight from tall shuttered windows.
images.salines: Coastal mangrove wetland behind a beach, wooden boardwalk crossing shallow lagoons, scarlet ibises and white egrets wading, mangrove roots, ocean glimpsed beyond, early morning mist.
images.bourda: Forest trail climbing a coastal hill at golden hour, opening onto a viewpoint over a long beach and brown sea, tall trees, lianas and heliconia flowers.
images.loyola: Moss-covered brick and stone ruins of an 18th-century Jesuit sugar plantation in tropical undergrowth, old millstone and arched kiln, shafts of light through tall trees.
images.diamant: Old 19th-century coastal artillery battery of weathered stone on a point at a river mouth, rusty cannon, mangrove shore, wide brown estuary at golden hour.
images.matoury: Dense primary rainforest interior on a hill, giant buttress-rooted tree, marked footpath, ferns, filtered green light, a blue morpho butterfly.
images.molokoi: Deep forest hiking trail with an open wooden carbet shelter where hammocks hang, mist between huge trees, a small clear creek, adventurous mood.
images.roura: Small riverside village on a calm dark river, white church with a bell tower, wooden canoes moored at a jetty, palm trees, reflections at sunset.
images.tresor: Elevated wooden boardwalk through humid montane rainforest, giant tree ferns, bromeliads and mosses, soft mist, gentle family-friendly feel.
images.csg: Distant view across savannah of a large generic white rocket on a coastal launch pad with a tall gantry tower, palm trees and tropical sky, no flags, no logos.
images.kourou-plage: Rocky seafront point with dark boulders and palm trees, people watching from the shore as a bright rocket trail rises into a pink dusk sky, small round stone watchtower.
images.zoo: A jaguar resting on a large branch in a lush naturalistic enclosure, dense tropical vegetation and a wooden walkway, dappled light.
images.annamites: Crumbling concrete and brick walls of an abandoned 1930s penal camp swallowed by jungle, roots and vines over doorways, solemn quiet light.
images.yiyi: Freshwater marsh with water lilies and tall grasses, a wooden observation hide on stilts, a spectacled caiman's eyes at the surface, herons, sunrise.
images.iracoubo: Interior of a small colonial church with every wall and vaulted ceiling hand-painted in naive colourful floral and religious motifs, warm light through doors.
images.transportation: Courtyard of a 19th-century penal colony camp with long whitewashed cell blocks, red tiled roofs, an iron gate and mango trees, late afternoon shadows.
images.relegation: Overgrown ruins of an old prison camp among tall grass and trees near a wide river, rusty roofs and brick walls, misty atmosphere.
images.javouhey: Rural Sunday morning market under open wooden shelters, Hmong women in colourful embroidered clothing seen from behind, baskets of vegetables, steaming soup, green hills.
images.mana: Quiet historic riverside village with old wooden Creole houses, a white church and a convent building, wide calm river with a pirogue, golden light.
images.maripasoula: Wide upper river with granite rapids and rocky islets, long wooden motor pirogues, forested riverbanks, a small riverside settlement with tin roofs, distant forested hills.
images.franconie: Elegant pale yellow Creole townhouse with blue shutters and a wooden balcony on a quiet street corner, palm tree, warm afternoon light.
images.montabo: Easy coastal footpath along a rocky shoreline with sea grape trees, leading to a small deserted sandy cove, waves, late afternoon.
images.vidal: Forest path through secondary forest ending at mossy ruins of a colonial plantation house with stone steps and a chimney, toucans perched in a tree.
images.topu: Hilltop forest trail viewpoint overlooking two small calm lakes surrounded by rainforest, wooden trail marker post without text, morning light.
images.fourgassie: Small waterfalls cascading over dark granite rocks into clear amber pools in primary rainforest, mossy boulders, sunbeams through the canopy.
images.coq-de-roche: A vivid orange Guianan cock-of-the-rock bird with its half-moon crest perched on a mossy rock ledge in a dim forest ravine, soft shafts of light.
images.roche-virginie: Vast bare dark granite dome (inselberg) rising above an endless sea of rainforest canopy, a hiker small on the rock, clouds, golden hour.
images.maripa: Wide river rapids rushing between dark granite rocks, an inflatable raft with paddlers, an open wooden carbet on the riverbank, forest all around.
images.montagne-singes: Wooden shelter on a forested summit with a sweeping view over the canopy toward a distant river mouth and a faraway launch tower, howler monkeys in a tree.
images.bois-diable: Calm freshwater town lake fringed with palm trees and a small sandy shore, people swimming gently, low buildings in the distance, sunny afternoon.
images.voltaire: Tall waterfall about 35 metres high plunging over a wide granite cliff into a pool in deep primary forest, spray and rainbow, hammocks at a rustic lodge nearby.
images.marche-slm: Lively early-morning riverside town market with colourful tarp stalls, piles of tropical fruit, cassava bread and spices, wooden canoes visible on the river behind.
images.z-cayenne: Aerial painterly view of a coastal peninsula city with red roofs, green hills and long beaches meeting a brown sea, small islets offshore.
images.z-est: Misty green mountains above a vast marshland stretching to the horizon, a winding red-earth road and a small Hmong village with vegetable gardens on a hillside.
images.z-savanes: Open coastal savannah with scattered palms and termite mounds, a town and a distant launch tower on the horizon, three small islands offshore.
images.z-ouest: Mighty wide brown river at dusk with long pirogues, forested opposite bank, a leatherback turtle track on a beach in the foreground.
images.z-oyapock: Border river with a long modern cable-stayed bridge in the distance, pirogues on the water, rapids and forested hills, dawn light.
images.z-sud: Endless rolling primary rainforest canopy under towering clouds, a lone bare granite inselberg and a small bush plane flying over.
images.it-cayenne-1j: Winding walk through a sunny colonial old town with Creole houses, palm-lined square, market awnings, ending on a beach at sunset in the background.
images.it-ile-nature: Footpath from forest edge toward ruins and a mangrove estuary, early light, binoculars and a water bottle on a wooden bench in foreground.
images.it-kourou-salut: Catamaran sailing toward a cluster of three green islands with old stone buildings, a rocket trail arcing in the sky behind.
images.it-cacao-kaw: Night scene of a pirogue gliding through a marsh under a starry sky, a guide's red headlamp beam reflecting in caiman eyes, misty mountains.
images.it-ouest-3j: Road trip along a straight road through savannah toward a big river, an old car with a roof rack, a painted church and a penal camp gate along the way.
images.it-grand-sud: Small bush plane parked on a red dirt airstrip surrounded by towering rainforest, hikers with backpacks walking toward the trees.
